_meta.purpose: 3-phase block periodization for intermediate lifters: accumulation → intensification → realization. 8-week cycle.

name: Block Periodization (Intermediate)
description: Classic linear-block model: build volume capacity (accumulation), convert to strength (intensification), then express peak strength (realization). 8-week cycle.

phases.name: accumulation
phases.label: Accumulation
phases.notes: Build work capacity and reinforce technique. High volume, sub-maximal intensity. Leave 2-3 RIR on working sets.

phases.name: intensification
phases.label: Intensification
phases.notes: Increase load, reduce total volume. Build strength expression. Leave 1-2 RIR on working sets.

phases.name: realization
phases.label: Realization
phases.notes: Peak strength expression. Low volume, high intensity. Heavy singles and doubles.
